description: rc.6 (review M2): with 130 adapters Settings is cut to the 900 pt clamp, and the adapter grid scrolls inside its bounded box: the grid is taller than the box, the box's scroll range reaches the grid's end, and the box and the footnote stay inside the window
notes: view.layout.adapters_scroll is the grid box's ScrollHandle at paint (views/layout.rs Layout::scroll): max_offset_y (how far it scrolls), visible_h and reachable_h = visible_h + max_offset_y. adapters_content is the grid itself (what the box scrolls through), adapters_box the box, hint the footnote, last_adapter the last switch.
No probe verb scrolls, so reachability is the scroll range, not a scroll: GPUI scrolls a container up to max_offset, and reachable_h >= the grid's height means that range reaches the last row.
Fails on 2734997 (the form without the flex_1/min_h_0 chain): the box takes the grid's full height, so it does not scroll and runs past the window.

steps.name: the panel is cut short: the grid is taller than its box
so the box scrolls (a positive scroll range)
scrolling reaches the end: the box plus its scroll range covers the whole grid
the last switch is past the box, waiting to be scrolled to
the box ends inside the window
the footnote stays under the box, inside the window
